messages:
lina_support: Customer reports they can't get the free trial granted — flow hits a payment-mandate check and returns a SCA/identity challenge that never completes. They see a 402-like blocking error in our API and Stripe shows `requires_action` repeatedly.

ajay_eng: Can you paste the request/response from our /grant_trial API and the Stripe payment_intent log (redacted)?

lina_support: yes — pasted response below (redacting PII):
```
POST /v1/grants
{ "user_id": "acct_ABC123", "promo": "NEW2026" }
200 OK
{"status":"blocked","reason":"payment_method_required","next_action":"present_to_user","provider":"stripe","provider_payload":{"pi": "pi_1F...","status":"requires_action","last_payment_error":null}}
```

lina_support: Stripe dashboard shows PI switching between `requires_action` and `requires_confirmation`, issuer returns `challenge_required` but ACS redirect doesn't complete — customer gets blank page.

kelly_billing: Does the customer have card on file? If not, our flow should prompt them to add one. Might be a redirect loop if our frontend isn't passing the `return_url` to Stripe. Any frontend repro?

ajay_eng: I looked at logs — our tokenization succeeded earlier but the `setup_intent` status is `requires_action`. Backend is calling `/confirm` with a `return_url` that our UI then needs to handle. In several retries the PI id is the same which suggests the client never received or followed the redirect.

lina_support: Customer says they click the 3DS modal and it just flashes then stays on `Processing...` forever. They tried Safari and Chrome.

tom_sre: Any errors in CDN or proxy? Could CSP/iframe blocking be preventing ACS from loading. I can tail the edge logs for the session.

ajay_eng: Please check the gateway logs for the /payments/confirm requests around 2024-07-21T14:02:xxZ (I attached trace id: tr_8b7f).

payments-bot: Payment gateway trace tr_8b7f: 302 -> ACS redirect -> 200 from acs.examplebank.com -> client did not POST back to /payments/callback within 60s -> PI timed out to `requires_action` again.

kelly_billing: Workaround: we can manually grant the trial from the admin panel while we investigate. Recommend doing that for this customer. Also we should check if `return_url` we generate has the right domain (customer uses a strict corporate CSP).

lina_support: I granted manual credit to unblock. Customer confirmed trial active. I'll keep this thread for root cause.

ajay_eng: Root-cause hypotheses: (1) client blocking 3rd-party cookies/CSP causing ACS iframe to fail, (2) our frontend drop of `return_url` on redirect for embedded webviews, (3) issuer ACS returning a JS challenge that our modal can't render. Next steps: get a repro with console logs and network capture; add more logging around `return_url` generation; instrument iframes failing metric.

tom_sre: I've added a temporary synthetic test hitting an example ACS with iframe; it fails on our staging when blocking third-party cookies. I'll open an infra ticket to add a header-check alert.

kelly_billing: Filing a billing process doc update: require explicitly documenting that customers in strict CSP environments must use our hosted payment page (not embedded) or consent to CSP exceptions.

lina_support: Thanks — marking as resolved for the customer. Keeping open for follow-up and playbook updates. :white_check_mark:
